soldier: Head capsule chestnut brown with a reddish tinge, pronotum chestnut brown, abdomen pale brownish yellow. Head capsule rectangular, rather glossy. Fontanelle flat, almost not projecting. Antennae 15–16-segmented, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about twice segment 2. Labrum nearly square. Mandible apices slightly curved, the lacinia of the maxilla with 9 marginal bristles. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave in a broad V with an additional U-shaped incision at the centre, the posterior margin almost straight at the centre, the median concavity ratio 21–24%, the midline faintly visible.
